text: 4.31 Advance Release Order (ARO) Application shall be filed online in ANF 4A to Regional Authority concerned for grant of ARO to procure inputs from indigenous sources / STEs. A suitable documentary evidence as outlined in Para 4.30 (c) of HBP shall be submitted, if applicable.
